verdict.rationale: DOR documents creating an online My DOR account for filing taxes and changing business details (wa-dor-docs-5). The probe confirms secure.dor.wa.gov sits behind a web login shell (wa-dor-probe-4), so the published sign-in path is a remote, credential-based online login rather than an in-person visit. Nothing in the pack describes the MFA method or rules out a mailed PIN or identity-proofing step during account setup. Missing for 10: documented MFA factor (TOTP/SMS/email) on My DOR sign-in, explicit confirmation that no mailed PIN, biometric liveness, or in-person verification is required to activate access, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sign-in flow.
